comment: DO NOT REGENERATE (rules-corpus.json discipline; frozen at the GH-491 review, build 18).

Per-ruleset byte oracle for the heyball-v1 conformance gate: every expect line harvested ONCE from the pool-rules crate through the pool-cli judge leg at the harvestedAt commit and reviewed case-by-case against its cited clause of the WPA Rules of Heyball (effective 2025-08-16; pin + digest at docs/research/rules-audit/heyball-rulebook-pin.md, PDF sha256 2b92dd5088ea630337326e26b7a2a7a4499a9801f2c5da7e5cc40421d5424a24).

Semantic source: crates/pool-rules/tests/heyball_scenarios.rs (51 reviewed scenes incl. interpretations I1-I5). Post-freeze changes ONLY via the erratum protocol (docs/rules/variants.md §4): a pinned-clause proof against the cited text -- NEVER a re-run to fix a red gate; a byte diff at any conformance leg is resolved by fixing the code to reproduce THESE bytes.

Coverage floor: initialState 2 / judge 35 (break matrix II.6, open-table II.10+II.12.1, closed play II.12+II.17, the II.20 loss family, frozen-cushion II.15.2, kitchen II.8+App-A 3.11) / judge-error 3 / applyDecision 12 (decisions 18-23) / applyDecision-error 4 / hudState 3 = 59 cases.

cases.comment: II.10.3: a fouled pot never assigns groups; the ball stays down (II.10.2).
II.10.1 tail: with all solids down a stripe pot closes the table; the opponent inherits the exhausted group.
II.17(b)/II.12.1: seat 1 (solids) contacts a stripe first.
II.17(b): the cue contacts nothing.
II.12.1: an own-group pot continues the turn (no call exists, II.11).
II.11 (flukes allowed): the opponent ball stays down; no own pot, turn passes.
II.12.2: no ball to a cushion after contact and nothing pocketed.
II.17(e) + II.12.3: a foul; the jumped ball is NOT re-spotted.

cases.comment: II.12.2 satisfied, nothing pocketed: a plain legal pass.
II.2 + II.11: a legal 8 pot wins — no pocket designation exists.
II.20(a): a foul while pocketing the 8 loses the rack.
II.20(d): the 8 pocketed before the group is cleared.
II.20(b) (interpretation I3): the 8 with the last own ball on one stroke.
II.20(c): the 8 driven off the table loses outright.
I5 note: an 8 slopped in while open is II.20(d)-early (no ownership).
II.15.2 (interpretation I4): the frozen target riding its own cushion never satisfies.
II.15.2: another ball (the cue included) to a cushion after contact satisfies.
II.15.2: a pocketed ball satisfies.
I4 strict reading: pre-contact cushion work never counts.
II.8 via II.17(i): first contact behind the head string, no crossing.

cases.comment: II.6(c) choice 1: accept the pattern — the chooser plays from here.
II.6(c) choice 2: re-rack, the chooser breaks.
II.6(c) choice 3: re-rack, the original breaker again.
II.6(e) choice 1: kitchen BIH as it lies — the II.8 restriction arms.
I2: an 8 driven off on the break returns under choice 1.
II.6(e) choice 2: re-rack, the chooser breaks.
II.6(f): the breaker spots the 8 and keeps shooting.
II.6(f): re-break, same breaker.
II.6(f) foul arm choice 1: spot-8 + kitchen BIH.
II.6(f) foul arm choice 3: re-rack, the original breaker.
II.6(g) choice 1: the chooser breaks.
II.21: the agreement re-racks for the ORIGINAL breaker.
Snooker's 17 is not a heyball decision id.
Choice 4 exceeds break_foul's choiceMax 3.
The decision must match the pending option.
